answer: Locks are logged in pulse, expire in sparrow, and hollow lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 153 aliases therefore needs 156 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3911 identities would post 4389 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
